_doc: Her pace while a press cast plays, by the angle between her travel and the aim (logic/Sim/CastMove.cs). fwd: share of her speed in the cone (absent: the record Walk, 0.7); cone: degrees either side of the aim; side: m/s cap at 90 deg; back: m/s cap at 180 deg; smoothstep between. A press record may carry its own castMove. Delete the castMove key for the old behavior.
